crossRefs.note: Leah conceived, and bore a son, and she named him Reuben. For she said, “Because Yahweh has looked at my affliction…
God listened to Leah, and she conceived, and bore Jacob a fifth son.
The sons of Leah: Reuben (Jacob’s firstborn), Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.
“Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength; excelling in dignity, and excelling in power.
Yahweh spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the Tent of Meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the…
After the plague, Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,
These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,
Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Paddan Aram, the sister of Laban…
Afterwards, she bore a daughter, and named her Dinah.
Dinah, the daughter of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Leah
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of six sons and Dinah

people.name: Paddan
people.line: The homeland of the patriarchs in Mesopotamia

translations.web: These are the sons of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob in Paddan Aram, with his daughter Dinah. All the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty-three.
translations.bsb: These are the sons of Leah born to Jacob in Paddan-aram, in addition to his daughter Dinah. The total number of sons and daughters was thirty-three.
translations.kjv: These be the sons of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob in Padanaram, with his daughter Dinah: all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three.
translations.asv: These are the sons of Leah, whom she bare unto Jacob in Paddan-aram, with his daughter Dinah: all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three.
